caption: The drawing depicts a metallic object composed of two main parts: a flat, curved blade and an attached handle. The blade, which is grayish-brown in color, has a roughly rectangular shape with one rounded edge and a small circular hole near one corner. Mounted on top of the blade are two thick, looped arms that rise up and curve into a single, large, oval-shaped handle. The handle and attachment points are rendered in a darker shade of brown, showing subtle highlights and shadow to suggest a metallic surface. The object is set against a plain, off-white background. Near the bottom right of the image, the name "N. Amantea" is written in small letters.
title: Chopping Knife
